source_snapshot.procedure: Enable listed EDKII debug/WHEA controls, deploy Intel ITP, boot Windows, log and halt, run mc.dimminfo(), require CAP on, then issue literal `ei.injectCMDParity(socket, hbm=-1, mc, channel)` and resume.
source_snapshot.criteria: System remains normal; BMC records a DIMM correctable error without slot information; front-panel and DIMM lightpath remain off; optional UEFI identifies the DIMM slot; Cscript reports successful CMD parity injection.

source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 1. Bios Setting EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> Lock Chipset -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> MSR Lock Control -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> EV DFX features -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> Disable BIOS Done -> [‘X’] EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> WHEA Error Injection Support -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> Whea PCIE Error Injection Action Table -> Enabled 2. Deploy Intel ITP environment. 3. Boot SUT into Windows. 4. Execute Intel Cscripts on the client 5. Using the following command >>>itp.log("C:\Test.log") >>>halt() >>>mc.dimminfo() 6. Check 'CAP' parameter in dimminfo is 'on'. >>>ei.injectCMDParity(socket, hbm=-1, mc, channel) >>>go 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. System should work normally 2. BMC error log should record DIMM correctable error but no slot info 3. Front Panel fault Light will not Light if there is one 4. Corresponding DIMM lightpath will not light if there is one 5. uEFI SEL Log should record which slot has DIMM correctable error if there is one 6. Cscript should show CMD Parity Error Injection is successful.
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- Memory controller 1~N (Intel DRAM parity on Memory controller 1~N error injection): requires CScripts/EDKII unlock (Lock Chipset=Disable, MSR Lock Control=Disable, EV DFX Features=Enable, WHEA Error Injection Support=Enable) + the user/FAE to drive the Cscript/error-injection harness for this exact pattern. Agent captures the post-injection evidence with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -180 | grep -iE 'parity|corrected|uncorrected'; echo __DRAM_parity_on_Memory_controller_1~N; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1".

source_conflict.reason: The literal call places positional `mc, channel` after keyword `hbm=-1` and is not executable as Python-like Cscript syntax. Controller 1~N lacks a map/count, parity severity is underspecified, Windows conflicts with dmesg, and optional/contrasting BMC no-slot versus UEFI slot evidence is not deterministic.
